title: The Hidden Treasure and Unexpected Consequences
style_guide: Realistic, low-quality, 360p look with natural colors, flat lighting, handheld phone photos, JPEG artifacts, no text overlays

scenes.narration: Stacy loved metal detecting. She learned from her grandfather.
scenes.visual: A close-up of a small hand holding an old metal detector in a forest, with trees and leaf litter in the background, low quality and slightly blurry.
scenes.image_prompt: photo of a child's hand holding a metal detector in a forest, 360p, natural colors, flat lighting, JPEG artifacts

scenes.narration: One day, she found a large silver coin under an oak tree.
scenes.visual: A low-res photo of a dirt patch near an oak tree, with a hand holding a shiny silver coin with engravings, simple composition, JPEG artifacts.
scenes.image_prompt: photo of metal coin in dirt near tree roots, 360p, natural lighting, JPEG compression artifacts

scenes.narration: Her social media post went viral quickly.
scenes.visual: A screenshot of a smartphone screen showing a simple social media post with a metal coin picture, comments below, low-res quality, slightly pixelated.
scenes.image_prompt: photo of a phone screen displaying a social media post with metal coin image, 360p, JPEG artifacts, flat lighting

scenes.narration: Police arrived, questioning Stacy about the coin found in the forest.
scenes.visual: A blurry photo of a small, cluttered police station room, with handcuffs and papers, two people partially visible, low quality.
scenes.image_prompt: photo of police station interior with two people, handcuffs or documents visible, 360p, natural, JPEG artifacts
